DIAGNOSIS READY: Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma.

Your history of a 50-year pack-a-day smoking history combined with alcohol use, significant weight loss, and painless jaundice (indicated by pale stools and dark urine) is highly concerning for pancreatic cancer, which often obstructs the common bile duct. Do you have any history of diabetes that was diagnosed recently or have you noticed new-onset high blood sugar?
